title: Le souvenir I (Tinctoris)
desc: Johannes Tinctoris, Le souvenir I. 2 voices (Superius, Tenor), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Tin3006); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
